main_text.l: Iosue, Deut.34.9. sanat Christus ægros, Luc.4.40.
MANUS paulò apertius consideratur, sequentibus distinctionibus, proprias & figuratas significationes ostendentibus.
1. Proprie igitur indicat membrum illud notissimum corporis humani, sive dextram sive manum sinistram intelligas, prout contextus fert.
2. Est cogitatio, actio, sive opus hominis, Genef.20.5, Exod.23.1 1.Sam.26.18. Iob.16 17.&31.7. Psal.7.4.&18.21. & 24.4. Esai.1.15. Ezech.18.8. Mich.2.1.&5.12. Iacob.4.8.
3. Administratio, Cura, Gubernatio, Inspectio, &c. Gen.30,39. Exod.38.28. Iudic.9.29 1.Sam.28,17, Esther.2.3, 14.Esai.3.6.Ierem.6.3.
4. Animus, metaphora a vigore externo, qui in manibus apparet, ad internum ducta. 1.Sam.23.16. Nehem.2, 18, & 6.9. Iob.4.3. Esai 35.3. Ierem.38.4. & 50.43. zach. 8 v 9.13.
8. Fides stans promissis, fidelitas, Gen.42,37,&43.9.1. Par.29.24.
9. Fortitudo bellica & politica, Deut.33.7 2.Sam.3, 18.1.Par.14.11.2.Par.15 7, Esdr.4.4. & 6.22. Exod.15 9.
14. Manus nomine indicatur potestas a Deo hominibus in res creatas, vel in alios homines, variis de causis modis certis & rationibus apertis aut arcanis concessa.
